title: 14-Inch Countertop Paper Towel Holder In Solid Brass | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep paper towels right where you need them and reduce countertop clutter with a dedicated countertop paper towel holder that stays in place and finishes your kitchen setup.

  • Quick access while cooking and cleaning — freestanding valet-style countertop design keeps a roll ready at hand
  • Built for everyday use — crafted from solid brass
  • Coordinated look — distinctive style from the Brass Paper Towel Holders collection
  • Clean installation details — concealed screw mounting hardware creates a finished appearance
  • Matches your fixtures — available in multiple designer finish options

Specs
Dimensions (L x H x W): 5" x 14" x 5"
Material: Solid brass
Assembly: Assembled in the USA
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
